server/routes.notes: Registers the route /feed for the English news feed.

server/routes.purpose: Generates an XML sitemap for news articles by querying a Turso database for visible articles and formatting their slugs and publication dates into sitemap entries.
server/routes.notes: Registers the route /sitemap-news.xml. Sets content-type to application/xml and cache-control headers.

server/routes.purpose: Generates an XML sitemap containing static pages, genre pages, streaming provider pages, production company pages, and festival pages for the Cinemagoria website.
server/routes.notes: Registers the route /sitemap-static.xml. Sets content-type to application/xml and cache-control headers.

server/routes.purpose: Generates the main sitemap index XML file, referencing the static and news sitemaps, while explicitly excluding dynamic sitemaps for movies, TV, and persons.
server/routes.notes: Registers the route /sitemap.xml. Excludes dynamic sitemaps to optimize Google's crawl budget for unique content.

server/types.purpose: Provides minimal ambient type declarations for the 'markdown-it' library, specifically for the MarkdownIt class and its options, to support server-side feed building.

server/utils.purpose: Provides utility functions for connecting to and executing queries against a Turso/libSQL database, including connection management and query timeout handling.
Constructs an RSS feed for news articles, supporting both English and Spanish languages and integrating database queries for article content and Vimeo oEmbed data.
Fetches and caches oEmbed metadata for Vimeo videos, providing thumbnail URLs and other details, used by news articles and RSS feeds.
Fetches and processes festival award data from the database for a given festival slug, supporting English and Spanish locales with fallback logic.
Manages canonical festival name-to-slug mappings and retrieves festival participation status for a batch of TMDB IDs from the database.
Provides utilities for fetching movie/TV show IDs from TMDB across multiple pages and generating an XML sitemap from these IDs.

services.purpose: Initializes and exports a Turso database client using environment variables, logging an error if required variables are missing.
services.notes: Exports null if IMDB_DB_URL or IMDB_DB_TOKEN environment variables are not set.

services.purpose: Provides a function to synchronize user data to a Turso backend API endpoint, handling network requests and error logging.

stores.purpose: Manages user cookie consent preferences, including loading from/saving to local storage, handling legacy consent, and providing methods to accept/decline all or customize preferences.
Manages the state of the search overlay, including its visibility and the page from which it was opened, providing actions to control these states.

types.purpose: Defines core database types, including a recursive `Json` type for flexible data structures and an empty `Database` interface for public schema tables, views, functions, and enums.

utils.purpose: Provides utility functions for interacting with various APIs (TMDB, Trakt, IMDb) and managing movie/TV show data, including enrichment and filtering.
Defines English display labels for editorial taxonomy categories and provides a function to retrieve the label for a given category token.
Exports a comprehensive list of countries with their respective ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes and names.
Provides utility functions for formatting dates, handling image loading errors, and determining the release status context of a media item.
Maps a raw item object to a standardized payload format suitable for database storage, inferring missing fields where possible.
Manages a session-wide cache for user membership data (watchlist and custom lists) to reduce API requests and improve performance.
Provides functions to search for soundtracks and retrieve album tracks using the MusicBrainz API.
Defines lists of supported news sources for different languages and their corresponding URLs.
Provides utilities to strip 'Related Articles' footers from article bodies and extract related article slugs from those sections.
